name: drupal/contentful_migration
description: Config-driven migration of a Contentful space export into Drupal, with Migrate API source and process plugins for Rich Text, assets, and reference resolution.

suggest.contentful/contentful: Content Delivery API SDK (^7.1) — only needed for live-fetch mode instead of consuming a contentful-export JSON dump.
suggest.drupal/entity_embed: Renders the <drupal-entity-embed> tokens migrated Rich Text bodies carry for embedded *entries* (embedded assets render on core media's media_embed filter).
suggest.drupal/graphql_compose: Schema-first GraphQL for decoupled mode (closest to Contentful's DX).
suggest.drupal/next: Next.js for Drupal companion — decoupled mode when the existing frontend is Next.js.
suggest.drupal/decoupled_router: Path/alias resolution for SPA routing in decoupled/semi-decoupled mode.
suggest.drupal/jsonapi_extras: Clean JSON:API resource names/field aliases for decoupled mode.
suggest.drupal/geofield: Required only if the source space uses Contentful Location fields.
